title: Anthony Clark’s Official Cause Of Death Revealed
summary: An official cause of death for Yes, Dear star Anthony Clark has been reported: The comedian, who passed November 10 at 63, died from septic shock, with influenza A and chronic alcoholism also included as underlying conditions. Acute kidney failure is added as a significant contributing factor. The details comes from a death certificate obtained […]

title: Global analysis reveals wildland-urban interface fires carry higher health burden
summary: Although wildland-urban interface fires make up a small fraction of total fire emissions, they are responsible for a much larger share of smoke-related premature deaths.

title: New article on humid heat trends in the Southeast United States
summary: Humid heat often worsens health risks of extreme heat by compromising human cooling mechanisms (sweating).
